reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the agreed deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is **19 November**.

On 14 October Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team. Later that day he corrected it in #north-random to 19 November, saying he'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of both channels, so I only used messages she can see herself. A signing date is an account detail rather than a money figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.

The original 21 December post is still in #north-team and hasn't been corrected there.
